cases.control: The firm does not contact the customer; the customer remains on the current plan.
cases.treatment: The firm contacts the customer and recommends a different plan with a lower monthly cost for the customer's usage.

cases.control: After a delivery failure, the customer is offered no price-based incentive.
cases.treatment: After a delivery failure, the customer is offered a discount or account credit.

cases.control: The customer is not invited to the marketplace community.
cases.treatment: The customer is emailed an invitation to join and participate in the marketplace community.
cases.metric: amount spent and listings created over the year

cases.control: The user is shown a generic brand or category banner.
cases.treatment: The user is shown a dynamic banner displaying the specific products the user previously browsed.

cases.control: The catalog presents the item without an installment-billing option.
cases.treatment: The same catalog presents the item with an installment-billing option added.

cases.control: The listing includes no instruction to compare the price against other items.
cases.treatment: The listing includes an added advisory to compare the price against similar items before bidding.

cases.control: Sale signs are placed on some of the products in a category.
cases.treatment: Sale signs are placed on most of the products in the category.

cases.control: The feedback widget asks a Yes/No question and then a follow-up question asking why.
cases.treatment: The feedback widget asks for a single 5-star rating.

cases.control: The pledge form presents a high suggested default amount, or no suggested default.
cases.treatment: The pledge form presents a low suggested default amount.

cases.control: The results page includes third-party content injected into the page by software on the user's device.
cases.treatment: The results page blocks third-party injection so only first-party content is shown.

cases.control: The product page does not show a star-rating summary near the top.
cases.treatment: The product page shows a star-rating summary block near the top.

cases.control: The cart page includes two coupon-code entry fields.
cases.treatment: The cart page includes no coupon-code entry fields.

cases.control: The registration form includes the full set of fields.
cases.treatment: The registration form includes the full set with three fields removed.
